name: Request Agent Task
description: agent_request: Delegate a task to an agent. Wait up to timeout milliseconds (default 5000); return the structured response if it finishes, otherwise a snapshot containing the task Job id and sessionId. Use timeout=0 for immediate submission. Follow the returned task id with the advertised Job tools on this venue; do not submit the task again to check its outcome. Input must contain self-contained instructions. Use responseSchema for structured output and outputPath for a path-based result handoff.

agentId.description: Agent reference: a bare name for the caller's agent, g/<id>, /g/<id>, or <ownerDID>/g/<id>

input.description: The request payload. MUST contain the actual instructions, data, or parameters the agent needs. NEVER pass an empty object {} — the worker has nothing to act on. Use field 'task' for free-form instructions; add other fields the worker needs (data, paths, options). Example: {task: 'summarise w/notes/daily', format: 'bullet list'}.

timeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for completion; default 5000. Use 0 for immediate submission. If the wait ends first, return the task Job snapshot for later observation. This differs from a result-wait timeout of 0, which waits indefinitely.

outputPath.description: Optional mutable Covia path for structural result handoff (for example w/pipeline/run1/chapter1, t/stage1, or an authorised DID-URL path). On successful completion the framework writes the worker's full result there under the requester's captured authority and returns a small {status, outputPath, bytes} receipt instead of the payload. Remote did:web paths are resolved through federation. If omitted, the existing direct output response is unchanged. Failed or cancelled tasks write nothing.

responseSchema.description: Optional JSON Schema for the task result. Shown to the agent as the target shape; advisory unless strict is set. Overrides the agent's config-level responseFormat for this task.

strict.description: Enforce responseSchema at task completion (default false). When true, a complete_task result that does not conform is rejected back to the agent with the validation diagnostics; the agent corrects it or fails the task. Requires responseSchema.

loads.description: Optional untrusted context to pre-load for the NEW session (the session tier of the context scope chain, #142): a map of key to entry spec, exactly as config.loads — {budget?, label?} under a lattice path or skill path, {skill: true} to pre-load a skill with its tools, or a spec declaring its own data source under any key: {text}, {op, input?} for a read-only operation observed before each inference and appended only when changed, or {job}. Non-skill values remain tool-result data; a caller-supplied trusted flag cannot grant system authority. Only valid when this call creates the session — an error if the session already exists.

sessionId.description: Optional session identifier (hex string, with or without a 0x prefix). Requests sharing a sessionId are treated as part of the same conversation. If omitted, a new session is created and its id returned in the response.

output.description: Either the agent's structured response (if it completed within the timeout) or a snapshot {id, status: STARTED, agentId, address, sessionId} to follow with the advertised Job tools on this venue. address is the canonical <ownerDID>/g/<agentId> target. Always carries the sessionId the task belonged to.
